text: I am providing an update on my participation in the 2025 Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO) AGM held August 16–18, 2025, and related advocacy efforts. The Key Highlights at the AGM were the following: 1. The Province announced $1.6 billion for the Municipal Housing Infrastructure Program to support housing growth and economic development. 2. AMO launched its first Indigenous Relations Action Plan. 3. Member engagement sessions gathered feedback on policy priorities. 2025 AMO Conference Highlights and Highway Advocacy | AMO The Priority Key Messages were the following: 1. Modernize the municipal-provincial fiscal relationship and provide long-term, predictable infrastructure funding. 2. Invest in solutions addressing homelessness, mental health, and deeply affordable housing. 3. Reassess Ontario’s property tax system to ensure fairness and predictability. 4. Support Bill 9…
